item.description: “Settler violence," was not mentioned until Hamas’ massacre on October 7, 2023. Shortly after that tragedy occurred, journalists, including Israelis, began to promote the canard. Opinion.

item.title: Jerusalem: 3 minors arrested on suspicion of damaging synagogue
item.description:
Three minors, residents of Jerusalem, were arrested on suspicion of involvement in causing damage to property at a synagogue in the city's Baka neighborhood.
Today, the police are expected to ask the court to extend the detention of the three.

item.title: Balad expects Supreme Court to overturn disqualification of its leader
item.description: Senior Balad official says Sami Abu Shehadeh article, which was interpreted as expressing support for the October 7 attack, was analytical in nature and did not constitute an expression of his position.

item.title: Top rabbi blasts Mamdani: He is the architect of antisemitism in New York
item.description: Rabbi Marc Schneier accuses New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani of fueling antisemitism after Mamdani again called Netanyahu an “architect of genocide."

item.title: Iran threatens 'crushing' strikes after Trump UN speech
item.description: Iran’s military warns of “crushing" strikes against the US and Israel after Trump’s UN speech and threat to strike Pickaxe Mountain.

item.title: Mystery in Sinai: Where are the three Israelis?
item.description: Three Israeli Bedouins were detained on their way back from Sharm el-Sheikh six months ago. Their families still do not know where they are being held or what condition they are in.

item.title: Burnham: Threats against Israel do not justify its actions in the West Bank
item.description: British PM criticizes Israel at the UN over its policies in Judea and Samaria and defends Britain’s trade ban on “settlement goods".

item.title: Ontario synagogue shooting suspect dies
item.description: The man suspected of opening fire on a police officer outside a Belleville synagogue has died.

item.title: Witkoff, Kushner hold indirect talks with Iranian mediators
item.description: Trump says US officials met Iranian mediators in New York to discuss a possible deal to end the Iran conflict, calling the talks productive. Witkoff stresses the talks were indirect.

item.title: Danon blasts Macron: Do your homework before lecturing Israel
item.description: Israel’s UN Ambassador Danny Danon slams French President after he claimed Hamas has never been active in Judea and Samaria.

item.title: 17-year-old girl moderately injured in motorcycle accident in Modi’in
item.description:
A 17-year-old girl was moderately injured after the motorcycle she was riding was struck by a vehicle in Modi’in.
Magen David Adom paramedics evacuated her to Shamir-Assaf Harofeh Hospital.

item.title: Syrian President: It is not possible for October 7 to dictate Israel’s policies
item.description: Speaking in New York, Syrian President Ahmad al-Sharaa says Israel withdrew from security talks after the sides had nearly reached an agreement, while insisting the Golan Heights are Syrian.

item.title: Report: IDF carries out controlled explosion in southern Lebanon
item.description: Lebanese media reported that the IDF carried out a large controlled explosion near the town of Khiam in southern Lebanon.

item.title: Trump warns Iran: We may have to blow up Pickaxe Mountain
item.description: President Trump says that the US could “blow up" Pickaxe Mountain near Natanz if Iran resumes nuclear activity at the site.
